review_type: Independent adversarial static review of frozen generation consumer/download integration

findings.finding: Persisted checkpoint/public endpoint contract comparisons use Python dictionary equality. A restamped sealed value1 compares equal to true, and a coverage bool can compare equal to integer0/1, despite the exact typed replay contract.
findings.impact: Native evidence and audit are independently reconstructed, so this alone does not invent associations or bypass unknown-policy review; it admits an altered typed completion contract.
findings.repair: Use the module existing encoded() helper (or equivalently strict type-preserving canonical comparison) at both boundaries.
findings.acceptance: A fresh-instance public replay and restore reject a restamped nested contract int/bool or int/float mutation, while unchanged real producer completion still passes.

checked_controls: Constructor loads the active sealed generation through the actual consumed-input reader; all five generation/policy roles become mandatory snapshots. Native JSON locators come from that validated generation and retain shared SourceAdmission.

Old root bulk files no longer establish authority or shadow the active generation. An explicit data_file must select the sealed catalogue. Native parsed-payload hashes separately preserve JSON value types and per-record identity.
Strain state lookup is exact catalogue endpoint lookup. unknown_unavailable returnsNone, explicit_empty returns[], and nonempty requires actual native rows. Missing or unresolved evidence is refused.

Producer contract version advances to3 and includes detached endpoint-generation evidence. Both producer completion and public replay require full generation/policy reconstruction, exact audit bytes and omission guards.

Endpoint audit projects all exact endpoint heads and source timestamps. Both explicit_empty and unknown_unavailable endpoints are forbidden from gaining either positive or negative strain-growth predicates in the source graph.
Fresh checkpoint restoration requires current validated native inputs and a matching completed audit; it cannot substitute a stale pre-generation completion record.

Download wrapper keeps acquisition import local, removes file-size authority, replays a current generation without HTTP, and refuses corrupted generation before fallback; refresh constructs a fresh generation and keeps old artifacts.

Read-only inspection of new tests confirms explicit-empty versus unknown semantics, fresh producer/public replay, historical-root shadowing refusal, body/policy/outcome/pointer drift refusal, restamped audit semantics refusal and unsupported growth refusal. Download tests cover actual persisted explicit-empty replay and corrupt-generation refusal.

Synthetic consumer fixture preparation preserves copied original bytes and derivation hashes, names synthetic catalogue context explicitly and reconstructs first-occurrence exports consistently; immutable historical resource files are not rewritten by that helper.
limitations: This reviewer ran no tests. Root coordinated focused consumer tests separately.
The acquisition/outcome defects in #1765/#1766 remain governed by production-acquisition-independent-review-1.json until corrected source and offline controls are reviewed.
The narrow default data-file behavior intentionally requires the sealed catalogue; this review does not claim arbitrary historical catalogue paths remain admissible.
